expectations.text: States the governing instrument: ANPD Resolution 19/2024 (the international transfer regulation)
expectations.evidence: "the practical route is the ANPD standard contractual clauses (Resolution CD/ANPD 19/2024), adopted without modification"

expectations.text: Lists the mechanisms: adequacy decisions (none issued to date), ANPD standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, specific guarantees
expectations.evidence: Lists mechanisms but contradicts the no-adequacy ground truth: "The EU/EEA is treated as adequate from January 2026" / "the January 2026 Brazil-EU mutual adequacy" — asserts an adequacy decision exists, conflicting with "none issued to date"

expectations.text: States the SCC deadline reality: the 12-month grace period ended August 23, 2025 — ANPD SCCs must now be incorporated in transfer contracts (old DPA language doesn't suffice)
expectations.evidence: "The grace period ended 23 August 2025. Adopt without modification"; pitfall: "Relying on a modified or custom DPA instead of the unmodified ANPD SCCs"

expectations.text: Notes transparency/documentation duties around transfers (RoPA, notice to data subjects)
expectations.evidence: "Transparency (Art. 9): tell data subjects that data goes to the US parent... Records: reflect the transfer and mechanism in your RoPA"

expectations.text: Practical advice: audit existing intercompany agreements for ANPD SCC incorporation; don't rely on consent as a transfer workhorse
expectations.evidence: "Inventory the data flows... Execute the ANPD SCCs"; consent is "Fallback only... Fragile and revocable, so not suitable for routine HR or customer data"
